# Sending verified Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic results

Pearson does not send official hard copy results to those who have taken the Pearson Test of English (PTE), so we are unable to accept submitted results sheets as certified correct copies.

So that the University of Auckland can verify your PTE Academic results online, you need to give us the proper authorisation to your results. To give us the right access to your PTE Academic results online, please:

1. Log into your PTE account by visiting the [Pearson Test of English website](https://www.pearsonpte.com/)
2. Click 'Send Scores'
3. In the field marked 'Institution/Organization/Department/School,' type 'University of Auckland'
4. Click 'search'
5. Tick the box next to 'University of Auckland' when it appears in the list
6. Scroll down the page and click 'Next' and 'Next again to confirm

You can then submit your uncertified result sheet in your University of Auckland admission application portal. Our Admissions Office can access and verify your results online.

To access your application, please visit [Continue your application](https://www.auckland.ac.nz/en/study/applications-and-admissions/apply-now/continue-application.html).
